contentList.content: You gain one Ki Point per level, which are restored upon taking a <LSTag Tooltip="ShortRest">Short Rest</LSTag>. Ki Points fuel various techniques as a Monk, allowing you to be more effective and versatile in combat.

Your weapons and unarmed damage may scale using your Dexterity, rather than your Strength. This can be toggled at any time.

Additionally, you are able to benefit from Free Handling while you are unarmed, and you regain Ki Points each turn equal to your Proficiency Bonus minus one.

Furthermore, upon reaching character level 9, your weapons deal 1d12 base damage per hit, rather than 1d8, if dual wielding.

When expending <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> in order to make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, the number needed to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> is reduced by one.
When expending <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> in order to deal damage, the lowest number you are capable of rolling is a 8.

You focus your ki to bend the elements to your will, using them as an extension of your own body.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

This <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag> is considered an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Unarmed Attack Roll</LSTag>. As such, it rolls using your <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> or <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag>, depending on which is higher.

Gain a magical variant of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FlurryOfBlowsMagic">Flurry of Blows</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UnarmedStrike_MonkMagic">Unarmed Strike</LSTag>. These actions are considered to be <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrips</LSTag>.

Utilize your Ki Points to cast Spells which require an Action or Bonus Action, rather than Spell Slots. The cost of a Spell is equal to one Ki Point per level of the Spell that you cast. This can be toggled at any time.

In addition, both your Flurry of Blows and Unarmed Strike are considered to be Cantrips.

Affected creature can utilize their <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> to cast Spells which require an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Action</LSTag>.

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_FangsOfTheFireSnake">Fangs of the Fire Snake</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FistOfUnbrokenAir">Fist of Unbroken Air</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShapeTheFlowingRiver_IceBlock">Ice Block</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_WaterWhip">Water Whip</LSTag>.
Conjure a flaming projectile and strike your foe from afar. Your next melee attacks deal an additional [1].
Affected creature's fists are flickering with flame. Its melee attacks deal an additional [1].
Conjure a gale in the shape of a fist which crashes into targets, forcing them back by [1].

Conjure a climbable block of ice which you can use to block paths and traverse your surroundings.

Enemies starting their turn within [1] of the block will potentially lose 50% of their Movement Speed and take [2].

Affected creature potentially takes [1] while starting their turn within [2] of the nearby <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShapeTheFlowingRiver_IceBlock">Ice Block</LSTag>. Upon taking damage by the Ice Block, they will lose 50% of their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> for the rest of their turn.
Affected creature has lost 50% of their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> for the rest of their turn.
Conjure a current of water with which to pull a target [1] closer to you.
This action utilizes an unarmed based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> while also functioning as a <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag>.

When dealing damage with a Spell or <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrip</LSTag>, infuse your spirit with the same element for the rest of your turn. Dealing further damage while infused will deal additional elemental damage equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Bludgeoning damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Slashing damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Piercing damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Acid damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Cold damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Fire damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Force damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Lightning damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Necrotic damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Poison damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Psychic damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Radiant damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.
Affected creature deals an additional +[1] Thunder damage to non-allied targets until the beginning of their next turn.

Spells cast with <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag>, as well as your <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrips</LSTag>, make their <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage rolls with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Upon a successful killing blow on an enemy with a Spell cast using <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag>, you refund the Ki Points spent in order to cast. Killing blows with <LSTag Tooltip="Cantrip">Cantrips</LSTag> restore one Ki Point. This effect can trigger once per turn.

When you use <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag> to cast a damage dealing Spell, gain <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to that type of damage until you cast again.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Bludgeoning damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Slashing damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Piercing damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Acid damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Cold damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Fire damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Force damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Lightning damage.

Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Poison damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Psychic damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Radiant damage.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag> to Thunder damage.

With the unpredictable lurches of a tippler, you sway through every battle, frustrating foes with carefully executed movements concealed beneath a façade of incompetence.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag>, deliver two hits in rapid succession. If your target is Inebriated, this action will potentially knock them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="UNCONSCIOUS">Unconscious</LSTag> for one turn, removing the condition.
Throw bottles of alcohol as a free action, causing all who get a taste to become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag>.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag>, belch a breathtakingly pungent scent so debilitating that it may rob those affected of their senses, driving them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Mad</LSTag>.

You are immune to the negative effects of being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TIPSY">Tipsy</LSTag>, and all positive effects are doubled. Upon consuming alcohol, you recover one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag>.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TIPSY">Tipsy</LSTag>, dealing damage with melee based <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> will deal additional damage to all enemies within [1] of your target, equal to your levels in Monk.
Dealing damage causes your target to become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag> for three turns.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TIPSY">Tipsy</LSTag>, you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on both <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage rolls.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DRUNK">Inebriated</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="TIPSY">Tipsy</LSTag>, all enemies make <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against you with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>.

Upon taking damage by a melee attack while Inebriated or Tipsy, you immediately fall Prone. Enemies have Disadvantage when targeting you while Prone, and standing up requires no Movement Speed. Upon standing back up, all damage you deal will always roll as a Critical Hit for the rest of your turn.

In addition, when targeting an Innebraited or Tipsy creature, the number you need in order to roll a Critical Hit is reduced by 2.
Affected creature will roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> when dealing damage.

Through harmony, your guiding hands provide relief. Through practiced inner peace, those around you are blessed with a calming sense of solidarity.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Healer

You are considered to be a priority target. This can be toggled at any time.

In addition, each turn, and when dealing melee damage to an enemy, you heal yourself and all allies within [1] of your target for an amount equal to your Wisdom Modifier.

When an ally within [1] of you is damaged, you may expend one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag> in order to heal all allies within [1] of you for an amount equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>.
When an ally within [1] of you is damaged, heal all allies within [1] of you for an amount equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>.
Healing an ally provides the effects of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_LesserRestoration">Latent Restoration</LSTag>.
<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="Tooltip_MendingBlows">Mending Blows</LSTag> now also triggers upon ending your turn.
Healing an ally provides the effects of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_GreaterRestoration">Great Cleanse</LSTag>.

When dodging an enemies <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>, you restore <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> to yourself and all allies within [1] equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>, so long as they are not <LSTag Tooltip="Downed">Downed</LSTag>.

You specialise in unarmed combat, using your hands and your control of ki to inflict grievous wounds.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

You specialise in unarmed combat, using your hands and your control of ki to inflict grievous wounds.

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_OpenHandTechnique_Knock">Flurry of Blows: Topple</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_OpenHandTechnique_NoReactions">Flurry of Blows: Stagger</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_OpenHandTechnique_Push">Flurry of Blows: Push</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UnarmedStrike_Monk">Unarmed Strike</LSTag>.
Deliver two lightning fast blows and possibly knock your target <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="PRONE">Prone</LSTag>.
Deliver two lightning fast blows and possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DAZED">Daze</LSTag> your target.
Deliver two lightning fast blows and possibly push your target [1] away.
Gain the ability to cast the standard variant of <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FlurryOfBlows_Free">Flurry of Blows</LSTag> as an <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Action</LSTag> at any time.
Deliver a debilitating blow to your target, possibly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="STUNNED">Stunning</LSTag> them.

The natural attunement you hold over your Mind, Body, and Soul strengthens your unarmed abilities. Depending on which paradigm you choose to attune to, you deal additional Psychic, Necrotic, or Radiant damage, equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>. These can be toggled at any time.
Your hands interrupt the flow of Ki to your enemies' minds. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
Your hands sap the Ki from your enemies' bodies. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
Your hands become infused with Ki drawn in from outside your body. Your unarmed attacks deal an additional [1].
Hit a creature with your bare fists, forcing the Ki in your targets body to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KI_RESONATION">Resonate</LSTag> with yours.
You can then force the Ki to explode with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_KiResonation_Blast">Ki Resonation: Erupt</LSTag>.
Detonate the Ki of a creature <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KI_RESONATION">Resonating</LSTag> with you, damaging the creature along with all enemies within [1] of it.
Detonate the Ki of a creature <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KI_RESONATION">Resonating</LSTag> with you, damaging the creature along with all enemies within [1] of it.
The Ki within the affected creature is resonating with a nearby Monk. The Monk can use <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_KiResonation_Blast">Ki Resonation: Erupt</LSTag> to make it explode.
Once per turn, killing an enemy will restore one of your <LSTag Tooltip="Action">Actions</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">Bonus Actions</LSTag>.

You value the arts of stealth and subterfuge, bending the shadows to your will to strike without warning.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShadowStep">Shadow Step</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_CloakOfShadows_Monk">Cloak of Shadows</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShadowStrike_Instant">Shadow Strike</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShadowStrike_Instant_Unarmed">Shadow Strike: Unarmed</LSTag>.
Teleport directly to a nearby shadow and gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> until the end of your turn.
While <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hidden</LSTag>, this action does not cost a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag>.
Affected creature has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.
Wrap yourself and nearby allies in shadows to become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CLOAK_OF_SHADOWS_MONK">Invisible</LSTag>. Allies in unobscured areas will remain visible.
Teleport to an enemy from a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Hide">Hidden</LSTag> position, striking them with the psychic ferocity of the shadows themselves.
If casting this action results in a killing blow, it is considered a free action.

While obscured in shadow, you may <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="HIDING">Hide</LSTag> as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>. Additionally, you can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of [1], and starting your turn while obscured in darkness will restore one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag>.

Upon landing a killing blow with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShadowStrike_Instant">Shadow Strike</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_ShadowStrike_Instant_Unarmed">Shadow Strike: Unarmed</LSTag>, all further <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> will be considered <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag> for the rest of your turn.
Affected creature will only roll <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag> when making an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag>.

Enemies within [1] of you have their peripheral vision severely reduced during combat. In addition, dealing damage to an enemy will <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">Blind</LSTag> them for one turn.
Affected creature is severely reducing nearby enemies' peripheral vision.
Affected creature has had it's peripheral vision severely reduced.
Upon starting combat, you immediately gain <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AUSPICIOUS_SHADOWS">Auspicious Shadows</LSTag> for one turn.
While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AUSPICIOUS_SHADOWS">Auspicious Shadows</LSTag> is active, you will always roll the maximum damage possible when dealing damage.

A stillness within the air around you gives pause to the most reckless of foes. You overwhelm within a cascading aura of unnerving calm - your hand resting soundly on the hilt of your weapon in subtle anticipation.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Gain the ability to summon a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Summon_TemperedBlade">Tempered Blade</LSTag>, which grows in strength alongside your levels in Monk. In addition, you gain the ability to perform <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_JudgementCut">Judgement Cut</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MirageBlade">Mirage Blade</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_TemperedStrike">Tempered Strike</LSTag>.

Summon a tempered blade, capable of cutting through any defense. As you level in Monk, it will deal additional damage and gain new effects.

Summoning your tempered blade may be done at any time as a free action.
Folded innumerable times over, this blade is impossible to touch without drawing blood. Unnerving power can be felt emanating from within.

Dealing damage with this weapon afflicts your target with one stack of both <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleeding</LSTag> and with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>.
Applying <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleed</LSTag> to a creature with this weapon causes them to take the Bleed damage when both starting and ending their turn.
When making an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleeding</LSTag> target, you roll with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Target a creature from afar with your equipped main-hand weapon.

Your target must be below 34% of their maximum Hit Points or Bleeding.
Target a creature from afar with your equipped main-hand weapon, teleporting to their position. In addition, you may instead target the ground in order to teleport to an area you can see.
Deliver a focused blow with your main-hand weapon, dealing twice as much base damage as a normal strike.
When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore all physical <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistances</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunities</LSTag>.

<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_JudgementCut">Judgement Cut</LSTag> now targets creatures within [1] of your original target. In addition, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MirageBlade">Mirage Blade</LSTag> is now capable of targeting two separate creatures, rather than one. Finally, when dealing damage to an enemy with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_TemperedStrike">Tempered Strike</LSTag>, you roll your damage with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.
When dealing damage to non-allied targets with your main-hand weapon, you add your base unarmed damage to the damage dealt.
At the start of each turn, you regain one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag>. In addition, ending your turn without moving will restore an additional Ki Point.

When targeting a creature with all of their <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_JudgementCut">Judgement Cut</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_MirageBlade">Mirage Blade</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_TemperedStrike">Tempered Strike</LSTag> will always trigger a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, and will deal the maximum damage possible.

Feel the breadth of your experiences circulating within you.
Within every storm, serenity harmoniously waits for its moment.

When an enemy fails to damage you with a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag>, use your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag> and a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Point</LSTag> in order to retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FlurryOfBlows">Flurry of Blows</LSTag>.
When an enemy fails to damage you with a <LSTag Tooltip="MeleeWeaponAttack">Melee Weapon Attack</LSTag>, retaliate with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FlurryOfBlows">Flurry of Blows</LSTag>.

When you successfully roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> against an enemy, restore one of your <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="KiPoint">Ki Points</LSTag>. This effect can trigger once per turn.

On any successful <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy, gain a +1 bonus to your <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag>, up to a maximum of +20, until you successfully avoid an attack. This effect can stack and will reset at the beginning of each of your turns.

Affected creature will avoid damage more easily. Their <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> increases by 1 for each stack of Dance of Flowing Water. This effect will reset at the beginning of each of their turns.

When a <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">Ranged Weapon Attack</LSTag> is made against you, reduce the damage by -1d12 plus your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Dexterity Modifier</LSTag> and your level as a free <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">Reaction</LSTag>. If reduced to zero, you may throw the projectile back at your aggressor.

When a <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">Ranged Weapon Attack</LSTag> is made against you, reduce the damage by -1d12 plus your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Dexterity Modifier</LSTag> and your level.

When <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Interrupt_DeflectMissiles">Deflective Reflex</LSTag> has reduced the damage of a <LSTag Tooltip="RangedWeaponAttack">Ranged Weapon Attack</LSTag> to zero, throw the projectile back at your aggressor.

When a Spell or effect would deal half damage on a successful <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag>, it deals no damage if you succeed, and only half damage if you fail.

When an enemy fails an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against you, gain a +1 bonus to Attack Rolls during your next turn. This effect can stack and will reset at the end of each of your turns.

Affected creature will land <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> more easily. The number required is reduced by 1 for each stack of Fist of Crushing Rock. This effect will reset at the end of each of their turns.

When you succeed in an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> against an enemy, the number you need in order to roll a <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> is reduced by 1. This effect can stack and will reset at the end of each of your turns, or upon rolling a Critical Hit.

Affected creature will roll <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hits</LSTag> more easily. The number required is reduced by 1 for each stack of Focused Stream. This effect will reset at the end of each of their turns and when rolling a Critical Hit.
Gain status immunity to being <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">Frightened</LSTag>, or restrained in any way.
<LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_FlurryOfBlows">Flurry of Blows</LSTag> deals additional damage to non-allied targets equal to your <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityModifier">Wisdom Modifier</LSTag>.
Gain an additional [1] of <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag>.

Gain <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on all <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
